sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Opening ⚙️ Settings from the Tampermonkey script menu or from MusicBrainz's own "Editing" menu now gives you the same dialog as the ⚙️ toolbar button. Those two routes used to be second class: the 💾 Save configuration and 📂 Load configuration buttons were missing, and 🔧 Edit Pinned Filter List did nothing at all when pressed — with nothing on screen to say why.

The Default column now says what a setting's default actually is. The five editable lookup tables showed the literal word "undefined", the 🔧 button entry showed an internal function name, and every "pipe-separated" setting showed the text "(pipe-sep.)" instead of its value — the format rather than the default, for exactly the settings whose defaults are hardest to reconstruct by hand.

SAVE no longer reloads the page when you changed nothing. The reload is how a changed setting takes effect, but it also throws away whatever the page had already fetched, so paying it to apply nothing was pure loss. The dialog header's claim that settings are "applied IMMEDIATELY upon saving" was never true and now says what really happens.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: You can now see what you have changed. A setting that differs from its default is marked with an orange edge and a bold name, every section header carries a ● badge counting the changes inside it — visible while the section is still collapsed — and a new ● Changed only button in the toolbar filters the dialog down to just those settings. Across 238 settings there was previously no way to answer this short of exporting the configuration and diffing it against a fresh one.

Sections remember whether you left them open. Every one of the 38 used to re-collapse on every open, so finding the setting you adjust regularly meant the same hunt every time. The first open is still all-collapsed.

Search and collapsing no longer fight each other. Searching now hides sections that contain no match, instead of leaving all 38 headers standing with nothing under most of them, and opens the ones that do — a match inside a collapsed section used to appear underneath a header still drawn as closed. Clearing the search puts every section back exactly as you left it, and a search that matches nothing now says so rather than showing an empty dialog.

Each section header has a ↺ button that resets just that section — and only the settings in it that actually differ, telling you how many first. The single global RESET across 238 settings was the button nobody dared press. Like RESET, it changes only the dialog: nothing is stored until you press SAVE.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: ❓ Help gains FINDING YOUR WAY AROUND THE SETTINGS DIALOG, RESETTING and SAVING sections, and its note that the 💾/📂 buttons are missing from two of the entry points is replaced — that was the bug, and it is fixed.
